metadata.description: A conversation woven from many voices.

header.signInIntro: Enter the phone number you used before — we'll text a 6-digit code to bring back your conversation and what the room has shared.

landing.title: Gather around the fire.
landing.lede: A way to collect perspectives from the community and reflect them back in a coherent way — to help make sense of complex issues and questions together.
landing.aroundTheFire: For much of human history, we would gather around the fire and have long discussions to help make sense of things and integrate perspectives. This is a way to asynchronously gather around the fire — to collect nuanced opinions, ideas, and concerns around a given topic, and give a shape to the collective intelligence of the community.
landing.steepedInContext: You can have a conversation with an AI that has been steeped in our specific context at ESM — everything from our culture documents, to bylaws, to call transcripts from many of the calls we've had over the years. Through a fluid conversation it will gather your unique insights, and weave a nuanced overview so that everyone can better understand the prevailing opinions as well as voices from the edges.
landing.workInProgress: A work in progress that we're still building — feedback is encouraged and patience is appreciated.
landing.directoryWithPhone: Conversations you've completed, started, and ones still waiting for your voice.
landing.directoryWithoutPhone: Join one to start tracking your history here.
landing.verifyPrompt: Verify your phone in any session to see what you've finished and what you haven't started yet.

gate.title: See what others are saying
gate.body: While that runs, drop your number — we'll text a 6-digit code so you can come back later. Your responses are still shared anonymously with the group.

session.senseMakingNote1: Communities have always needed tools to understand one another. In the past, we sat around fires and yarned with each other.
session.senseMakingNote2: Now there are far too many of us to be around the fire together. This AI tool helps us collect opinions from as many neighbors as possible so that everyone's voice is heard.
session.senseMakingNote3: We will be recording your session with the AI and you'll have the option to see what others have said. We recommend you use the microphone to speak naturally to this tool like you would a neighbor. Excerpts from your chat will be shared anonymously with the community.
session.archived: This session is archived. You can still read the conversation, but it's no longer taking new responses.
